landing.meta: CRISTIAN CLOCK-SYNC • CC AUDIO • ZERO ADS
landing.subtitle: A real-time synchronized music player for friends, couples, and hangouts. No ads interrupting your moments. Not because we're nice — because we hate ads.
landing.friendCodePlaceholder: Have a friend's room code? Enter here...
landing.techDesc: Powered by an adaptation of Cristian's algorithm to measure round-trip time (RTT). The audio engine automatically corrects drift in real-time if a browser tab goes to sleep on mobile.
landing.saweriaDesc: If you and your partner or friends enjoy listening together here, consider buying a cup of coffee on Saweria to help cover our WebSocket server costs.

telemetry.title: CRISTIAN'S SYNC ENGINE STATS
telemetry.algoDesc1: Every 5 seconds, the PoySic server broadcasts a heartbeat with the current playback position. The client reconciles the offset:
telemetry.algoDesc2: If the drift exceeds 0.45 seconds (for example, if a phone browser sleeps), PoySic automatically seeks back into lockstep.

modal.syncDesc: PoySic uses a combination of Cristian's Algorithm and a Drift Correction Threshold to ensure audio plays simultaneously between partners or friends across any distance:
modal.driftDetail: The server emits a heartbeat every 5 seconds. If the difference between your audio player and the server estimate exceeds 0.45s, the audio hard-seeks to the exact second.
modal.zeroAdsShield: Zero Ads means no audio advertisements will ever break synchronization at critical moments.
modal.archDesc: The application is structured as an authoritative client-server model:
modal.archClient: Client (React + Tailwind): Handles HTML5 audio playback, animated vinyl visualizers, and clock offset calculations.
modal.archServer: Server (Express + Socket.IO): Acts as the single source of truth for rooms, queues, and playback state.
modal.archMusic: Music APIs: Delivers thousands of legal Creative Commons audio tracks seamlessly.
modal.phase1Desc: Cristian clock sync, audio drift correction, CC music search, synchronized queue, real-time chat & reactions.
modal.phase2Desc: Multi-language support, Audius decentralized music catalog, and vestibular accessibility.
modal.phase3Desc: Community Saweria support, mobile PWA capabilities, and password-protected rooms.
modal.donationPledge: PoySic is guaranteed 100% free of commercial ads forever.
modal.donationDesc1: PoySic was crafted with care to help partners, families, and best friends share music moments in real-time, no matter the distance.
modal.donationDesc2: Your contribution via Saweria helps us maintain real-time WebSocket servers, music API integrations, and low-latency connections.
modal.donationThankYou: Thank you for supporting an open, ad-free project! ❤️
modal.usernameDescUpdate: This name is visible to other listeners in the room
modal.nameHelp: This name will appear on player controls, the listener list, and live room chat.
